title: Head Engineering and Maintenance
description:
Role & responsibilities Candidate will be responsible as Head engineering at their USFDA approved Injectable Plant based at Navsari,Gujarat. • Candidate will be responsible for managing engineering projects, CAPEX plans, budgets, and plant improvement initiatives. • Candidate will be responsible for leading engineering teams, resource allocation, project prioritization, and technical guidance. • Candidate will be responsible for maintaining GMP, ISO, QA, EHS, safety, and regulatory compliance. • Candidate will be responsible for engineering and maintenance of pharmaceutical utilities including boiler, clean steam, WFI, PSG, compressed air, chilled/cooling water, HVAC, pumps, and water systems. • Candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting and overseeing mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, automation, and production engineering activities. • Candidate will be responsible for project planning, costing, budgeting, documentation, purchasing, inventory management, and SAP-related activities. • Candidate will be responsible for implementing engineering best practices and ensuring timely completion of projects and assignments. • Candidate will be responsible for coordinating with internal departments, external agencies, and regulatory authorities. Candidate Profile • Candidate should have B. Tech Engineering and experience in pharmaceutical engineering, project management, and technical operations in Injectable section. • Candidate should have thorough knowledge of mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, industrial engineering, and plant utilities. • Candidate should have experience in GMP/ISO-compliant pharmaceutical manufacturing environments and regulatory audits. • Candidate should have strong knowledge of CAPEX, budgeting, costing, inventory, purchasing, and SAP. • Candidate should have excellent leadership, communication, problem-solving, planning, and team-management skills. • Candidate should have the ability to manage multiple engineering projects and deliver results within timelines.

Key Skills: Injectables,Maintenance,Vial Washing,Engineering,Washing
